meta.revisionPolicy: Each ILOEST edition re-estimates the whole modelled history; the raw dump of the previous edition is archived under data/raw/vintages. Survey series change when the ILO reprocesses the unit data.
meta.note: As published in ILOSTAT from: OE - Official Estimates.
sourceNotes: Data reference period: End of the year (244 obs.)
Lower limit on coverage of strikes and lockouts: Excluding strikes with less than 10 workers (244 obs.)
Time unit for measuring time lost: Calendar days (63 obs.)
Workers involved: Workers directly and indirectly involved (63 obs.)
